text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with King Halo, 
but...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I just haven't been feeling quite 
myself lately...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I should pay a visit to a 
shrine. It'll at least bring some peace of 
mind."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall grant God the privilege of 
granting the King's wish!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you pray for whatever you want 
too? Just waiting around blankly is a 
waste of time."

“—And so, I ended up praying together with 
King Halo.”

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"In the next race, you shall grant King a 
magnificent and glorious victory—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And I will keep lighting the glorious road 
King walks with dazzling brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, good health, traffic 
safety, and may the underclassmen stay 
healthy too—!!

"...Beside me, I can hear King Halo's 
voice praying with extraordinary 
earnestness."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, that should do it, I 
suppose? You better grant my wish, okay?

—Suddenly, a gentle breeze brushed against 
my cheek.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a nice breeze. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm in better shape now. Turns 
out the gods are surprisingly 
understanding!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh... To even have the gods backing me 
up, it seems my charms have pierced the 
heavens themselves.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aaas expected of a first-rate Umamusume♪ 
Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

Afterward, King Halo was in top form 
during training as well.

A strong gust of wind suddenly howls 
through, making the surrounding trees 
rustle—

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Quark! Quark!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gyaah!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I felt an ominous presence just 
now...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
B-Bringing an omen of bad luck to a 
King... just what do you think you are 
doing?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I see what this is... They're 
begging us to buy them a good luck charm."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what a hopeless deity... Fine, 
just this once, I'll play along.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's hurry and go buy it. Before 
it sells out...!

Afterward, King Halo continued to clutch 
the amulet she had bought with an anxious 
expression...
